title: Snap a meal
intro: Log what you eat in seconds, or check where a Living Dose product came from.

photo.title: Take a photo of your plate
photo.body: It's saved with your diary entry, so you and your dietitian can look back on it.
photo.error: That photo couldn't be read. Please try another.

plate.title: What's on your plate?
plate.body: Search and add each part of your meal, then pick the portion size.
plate.noResults: Nothing found. Try a simpler word, like rice or soup.

review.title: Check and save
review.saltHigh: That's quite a lot of salt for one meal. Adults should have under 5 g in a whole day.
review.estimates: These are estimates. Home-cooked portions vary.

diary.title: Today's food diary
diary.removeConfirm: Delete this meal from your diary?
diary.planNote: Meals you tick in your meal plan are counted on your Home page.

guest.title: Sign in to keep a food diary
guest.body: Your meals, photos and totals are private to you.

product.title: Scan a product
product.body: Every Living Dose product has a code on the label. Scan it to see where your food came from.
product.cameraHelp: Point your camera at the QR code on the label.
product.cameraError: We couldn't open the camera. You can type the code instead.
product.noCamera: Camera scanning isn't available in this browser. Type the code printed under the QR code instead.
product.invalid: We don't recognise that code. Check it matches the label, for example LD-UGU-B0930.
product.harvested_other: Harvested up to {{count}} days before packing
product.packed: Checked and packed at the Living Dose hub, Lagos
product.noTrace: This product is made in our kitchen from traceable ingredients.

ai.found_one: We spotted {{count}} item. Check it and adjust anything we got wrong.
ai.found_other: We spotted {{count}} items. Check them and adjust anything we got wrong.
ai.noFood: We couldn't see any food in that photo. Try again with the plate in the middle of the frame, in good light.
ai.unavailable: Automatic recognition isn't switched on here, so add your foods below.
ai.error: We couldn't read your plate just now. Add your foods below.
ai.estimate: AI estimate for what's in your photo

tips.saltHigh: This meal is high in salt. Adults should have under 5 g in a whole day, so go easy on seasoning cubes and salty snacks for the rest of today.
tips.sugaryDrink: Swap the sugary drink for water or unsweetened zobo next time. That alone can save several teaspoons of sugar.
tips.fried: Something here is fried. Try boiled or roasted plantain, moi moi instead of akara, or grilled fish next time.
tips.addVeg: Add vegetables: a handful of ugu, spinach or a side of salad would make this meal more balanced.
tips.bigSwallow: That's a large portion of swallow. Aim for about the size of your fist and add more soup vegetables.
tips.bigMeal: This is a big meal. Make your next one lighter, and take a short walk after eating.
tips.addProtein: This meal is low in protein. Add beans, eggs, fish or chicken to keep you full for longer.
tips.balanced: Nicely balanced: vegetables, protein and not too much salt. Keep it up!

water.title: Water challenge
water.intro: Drink 8 glasses today. Take a live selfie each time you drink, and we'll count the glass for you.
water.how: Hold your glass or bottle up to your mouth, with your face in the frame. It has to be a live photo, taken now.
water.demoAccepted: Glass counted. (Demo: the selfie wasn't checked.)
water.rejected: We couldn't confirm that one. Make sure your face and your drink are both in the picture.
water.notSetUp: Selfie checks aren't switched on yet, so this glass wasn't counted. You can still add it on your Home page.
water.checkFailed: We couldn't check your selfie just now. Please try again in a moment.
water.tooSoon_one: Nice! Give it {{count}} minute before your next glass.
water.tooSoon_other: Nice! Give it {{count}} minutes before your next glass.
water.max: That's plenty of water for today. Well done!
water.privacy: Live camera only, so photos can't be uploaded. We check that a real face and a drink are in the picture; we don't identify who you are. Your selfies stay on this phone and are cleared tomorrow.

camera.label: Live camera
camera.deniedBody: To take a water selfie, allow camera access for this site in your browser settings, then reload the page.
camera.unsupportedBody: This browser can't open the camera. Try Chrome or Safari on your phone.
